subject: How one studio gets 20 bookings/month on autopilot
html:
Hey {{first_name}},


Most fitness studio owners spend hours chasing leads that never convert — texting manually, forgetting follow-ups, losing bookings to faster competitors.


One studio owner fixed that with a single AI automation: a 3-step follow-up sequence that triggers the moment someone fills out a lead form. Within 90 seconds of opt-in, the lead gets a personalized text. If they don't reply, the sequence follows up at hour 3 and day 2 — automatically. No manual work.


Result: 20 new intro sessions booked per month, consistently, without the owner touching a single follow-up.


The key isn't the AI itself — it's speed. Studies show leads are 21x more likely to convert if contacted within 5 minutes. Most studios are still responding in hours (or days). A single automation handles that entirely — set it up once and it runs while you're training clients.


Want me to put together a custom AI + marketing plan for {{business_name}}? Book a quick discovery call — schedule here


Dylan | Digigrowth
